pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped polygonal regions with crenulated edges and distinct pixel gradients. Patch area is significantly larger on the central flank compared to the smaller, more fragmented regions visible on the lower flank and towards the neck.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous negative-space pathways with stable continuity. Junction nodes are predominantly tri-radiate intersections. The pixel thickness of the pathways is relatively uniform across the lateral flank, widening slightly at junction points.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane exhibits a short, dense vertical fringe with a low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged 1D contour visible against the background along the upper neck and shoulder ridge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A localized, dark, circular nodular lesion or parasitic attachment is visible on the posterior flank area, distinct from the surrounding pelage pattern.
